scoring_justification: Checker independently solves the two-band Hartree-Fock equations for each (U,J) pair using scipy fsolve to obtain reference magnetization and energies, then compares agent’s reported values; this is a full recompute of the paper’s computational model.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values computed by the checker’s own solver; no external hidden file
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper equations (2)–(6) for two-band Hartree-Fock with free-electron DOS; parameters A1=1.00, A2=1.01, n=2. Reference values are recomputed on the fly.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Checker implements root-finding with scipy.optimize.fsolve for each (U,J) pair
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The reference is the direct solution of the physical model, so it is the true expected answer; no external hidden file is needed.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the computed relative magnetization M/(2μ_B) and ground-state energies per site for magnetized and unmagnetized solutions at absolute zero, for two parameter sweeps: (1) fixed J=0.1, U=0.2,0.3,...,0.8; (2) fixed U=0.3, J=0.0,0.1,...,0.5. The checker recomputes the self-consistent Hartree-Fock equations to obtain reference values, compares M_over_2muB within a tolerance, checks energy ordering (u_magnetized < u_unmagnetized), and verifies non-decreasing magnetization with increasing U and J.

steps.description: Recompute reference magnetization and energies for each (U,J) pair; compute fraction of rows where M_over_2muB within absolute tolerance 0.02, fraction with correct energy ordering, and monotonic trends. Final score = 0.7*frac_M_tol + 0.3*(0.5*frac_energy_order + 0.5*monotonic_score).
